app.title: Crystal Line Puzzle
app.descr:
Crystal Line is a relaxing puzzle game about connecting matching crystals without crossing paths. Fill every open tile, avoid dark blocks, and find a clear path through each challenge.
Explore 140 campaign levels across 7 chapters, then return each day for a fresh Daily Board. Simple controls and crystal-themed visuals make it easy to enjoy a short puzzle break or settle into a longer session.
Make the experience your own with these features:
- Personal Profile: Set your nickname and customize your avatar by taking a photo or choosing an image from your photo library.
- Gameplay Recording: Record your gameplay directly within a level. Choose whether to include microphone audio and save your favorite moments on your device.
- My Videos: Watch the built-in Level 1 tutorial, replay your saved gameplay recordings, and delete recordings you no longer need.
- Game Guide: Use quick questions, text, or voice input to ask about game rules, level progression, and Daily Board. Voice input becomes editable text that you can review before sending.
- Save Your Results: Save game results as images to keep a record of your achievements.
The puzzles can be played offline, and your progress, profile, and gameplay recordings are stored on your device. No account is required.
Connect the crystals, complete each board, and discover your next puzzle.
